title: Ask The Person Output
description: What the calling step gets back: proof the question went out twice, and the person's answer or the default taken. A dismissed card is not an answer.

asked.description: Where the two copies went. The chat copy is posted first.

chat.description: Id or link of the chat message holding the full question.

card.description: Id of the card offered after it; null only when the host has no card tool, which the chat text then says.

outcome.description: answered: the person chose. silent: no answer came. dismissed: the card was closed without a choice; the question stays open in the chat.

chosen.description: The letter chosen; null unless outcome is answered.

quote.description: The person's answer, verbatim, with who and when; null unless answered.

defaultTaken.description: true when the work went ahead on ifSilent. Never true for an irreversible step.

rule.description: When the answer settles how a kind of thing is decided: the skill it was written into, in the same turn.

stagingLinks.description: When the question asks the person to look at changed pages: the staging preview, one deep link per changed page with the same page on main, shown in the chat copy. When there is no preview, say so in `missing`. Rule: cat-harness skills/sdlc/sdlc-core/staging-review.md §"The deep-link rule".

stagingLinks.title: Staging links
stagingLinks.description: The staging preview of the work a request for feedback is about: one deep link per changed page (the page and the anchor where the change sits) with the same page on main as `before`. Mirrors StagingComparison in schemas/sdlc/staging.ts. The rule is skills/sdlc/sdlc-core/staging-review.md §"The deep-link rule". Copied inline as `definitions.stagingLinks` into every skill contract that carries it; schemas/staging.test.ts fails when a copy drifts.

slug.description: Branch slug used in the staging URL path.

pages.description: One entry per changed page, deep-linked; from the change's rendered-impact list, never chosen by judgement.

before.description: Same page on main; absent for a new page.

after.description: The page on the staging preview, with the anchor where the change sits; absent for a deleted page.

summary.description: What to look at on this page.

missing.description: What could not be linked, said rather than hidden: no preview yet (and when it will exist), no page list computed, or a changed page the publish ref does not hold.

stagingLinks.$comment: Copy of cat-harness schemas/staging-comparison.schema.json; cat-harness schemas/staging.test.ts fails when a copy drifts.
